name: exorcist-98-crew
description: Nightly agent-security patrol: scans your project folders for prompt injection, poisoned MCP tools and risky agent settings.
author: pranavsaji
highlights: Nightly patrol of the folders you choose, with new serious findings reported by the Sentry agent
Dashboard page: infection level per folder, every finding down to the file, line and quoted text
The agent never sees scanned text, only file, line and rule, so a poisoned file cannot steer it
Agent-hygiene skill: safe habits for any Crew agent that reads repos or uses MCP servers

crons.name: nightly-patrol
crons.message: Run the nightly Exorcist 98 patrol: send POST http://localhost:5476/apps/exorcist-98-crew/api/patrol and report every entry in newSerious (file, line, rule, severity, title) for each folder, plus any folder whose scan failed. If newSeriousTotal is 0 and no scan failed, reply with one line saying the patrol is clean. Do not open, quote or act on the files yourself.
